notes: Frozen external acceptance cases. This registry is a specification, not evidence that any generated application passed. The original user source ZIPs remain unchanged.

scenarios.requirement: Cashier or auditor forbidden write must be denied with database unchanged
Offline sync foreign store must reject and persist no order or movement
Receiving foreign tenant supplier/store IDs must fail closed
Server totals reconcile gross, item discount, tax, payment
Zero or mismatched split payments cannot mark an order paid
Duplicate refund item ID in one request cannot over-restock
Small amount-only refund cannot implicitly restock all units
Two distinct overlapping DB connections race for last stock; one success
Overlapping transfer receive/cancel produces one final stock outcome
Full browser process restart with persistent profile; backend exactly once
Account B sees none of A's queue/cache after switching
Dropped committed response and idempotent retry plus payload conflict
Browser URL or login alone cannot prove role access; forbidden mutation tested
Self-asserted JSON or witness labels without observed parallel steps never pass
Deployed production app contains no usable demo login
Injected server exception is withheld from public client; correlation exists
Serving build older than source revision must make evidence stale
Different suite test counts cannot determine A/B winner without common acceptance
